name: House hunter
tagline: Watches listings against your filters and models sell-to-buy math
description: Give it your budget, area and must-haves, and it hunts down the for-sale homes that match. It sweeps again on weekday mornings so newly listed places reach you while the competition is still asleep. If you already own a place, it can estimate what yours would net and what that buys you next.
author: Rebeldawg
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
